verdict.rationale: Extend documents a first-party web environment, Extend Studio, where processors are versioned and iterated on. That implies a no-code place to try parsing and extraction configurations before writing integration code. However, the evidence never describes dragging or uploading a document into a playground and viewing parse/extract results there. Missing for 10: an explicit drag-and-drop document upload in the web UI, documented display of parse/extract results in a playground, and hands-on or independent corroboration of a pre-code trial flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I drag a document into a web playground and see parse/extract results before writing any code

citations.quote: the thing you version and iterate on in Extend Studio, and the unit you evaluate and optimize
